newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Paracorp shares debut at 5.3 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Paracorp shares debut at 5.3 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Paracorp Bhd made their debut on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at 5.30 ringgit per share against an offer price of 3.65 ringgit each.
The electronic components and displays maker had issued six million new shares and offered for sale 4.351 million existing shares.
Paracorp has forecast a pre-tax profit of 23.77 million ringgit for the current calender year. It has also projected a gross dividend of 20 cents per share and gross earnings per share of 50.5 cents.
Its five manufacturing facilities mainly serve multinationals in the automotive, computer peripherals, consumer and industrial electronics, telecommunications and healthcare businesses.
